task_understanding: Create formulas in column G (G2:G19) to calculate employee incentive percentages based on a three-dimensional lookup: (1) Goal value determines which column of variance thresholds to use (4 buckets: <65%, 65-75%, 75-85%, 85-95%, 95%+), (2) Variance to Goal determines which row (4 ranges with different thresholds per goal bucket), and (3) Metric2 determines which column in the payout grid (6 ranges: <=-20%, -20% to -10%, -10% to 0%, 0% to 10%, 10% to 20%, >20%). Employees with negative variance or Goal < 65% receive no incentive.
proposed_approach: Use nested IF statements to first check eligibility (B column = 'Not Eligible' returns empty string)
Check if Goal (D column) is >= 0.65, otherwise return empty string
Determine Goal bucket using cascading IF statements (D < 0.75, D < 0.85, D < 0.95, else)
For each Goal bucket, use the corresponding column (J, K, L, or M) to determine Variance range using <= comparisons against thresholds in rows 3, 4, 5, with row 6 as fallback
For each Variance range (rows 3-6), determine Metric2 bucket using cascading IF statements (F <= -0.2, F < -0.1, F < 0, F < 0.1, F < 0.2, else)
Return the corresponding value from the payout grid (columns P-T, rows 3-6)
assumptions: The variance thresholds in columns J-M (rows 3-6) represent upper bounds for each variance range, with different thresholds for each goal bucket
The Metric2 thresholds in row 2 (columns P-T) represent lower bounds: -0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2
Values exactly equal to thresholds are included in the lower range (e.g., Metric2 = 0 falls in the 0-10% range, not -10% to 0%)
Employees with Goal < 0.65 receive no incentive (empty string)
The payout grid (P3:T6) contains the final incentive percentages to return
Rows 20-23 (Emp19-Emp22) are outside the answer range and don't need formulas
